title: Bram and the Protocol Again
author: Ulyana Almeida
blurb: Mara Dunmore, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before the fleet's truce expires.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
